item.title: German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier received His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani on Friday morning at Villa Borsig i…
item.description:
German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier received His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani on Friday morning at Villa Borsig in Berlin with an official reception ceremony, followed by talks on cooperation in trade, industry, energy and investment as well as regional issues. His Highness stressed Qatar's interest in holding the first round of the joint strategic dialogue and coordinating diplomatic positions, noting both countries' shared commitment to mediation and to supporting dialogue between parties to conflicts, while the German President expressed his wish to deepen the partnership at all levels on the basis of shared economic and security interests. The talks were attended by the Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs and the ministers of interior, finance, state for energy affairs, and commerce and industry.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/amir-german-president-discuss-strengthening-friendship-cooperation · Qatar Tribune (QNA) https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265625/latest-news/official-reception-ceremony-awarded-to-amir-in-german-capital-berlin · Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738626/qatar/official-reception-ceremony-accorded-to-hh-the-amir-in-berlin

item.title: Minister of Commerce and Industry Sheikh Faisal bin Thani bin Faisal Al Thani said trade between Qatar and Germany reached about USD 2.024 …
item.description:
Minister of Commerce and Industry Sheikh Faisal bin Thani bin Faisal Al Thani said trade between Qatar and Germany reached about USD 2.024 billion in 2025, up from USD 1.811 billion in 2024, growth of 11.8%, including Qatari exports of about USD 307 million (+16.7%) and imports from Germany of about USD 1.717 billion (+10.9%); Germany ranked as Qatar's 15th-largest trading partner, and 433 German companies operate in the Qatari market. Volkswagen Group described Qatar as a trusted long-term partner and saw scope to deepen cooperation in electric mobility, digital services and infrastructure. The chairman of Qatar Chamber and Qatari business leaders called for turning the partnership into joint productive projects.
Sources: Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738625/qatar/qatar-germany-strategic-partnership-poised-for-stronger-economic-ties · Qatar Tribune (QNA) https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265624/latest-news/volkswagen-group-hails-qatar-as-trusted-long-term-partner-sees-scope-for-deeper-cooperation · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/qatars-investment-capabilities-germanys-industrial-strength-lay-foundations-for-long-term-partnership · The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/amirs-visit-to-germany-serves-as-new-boost-to-bilateral-strategic-ties

item.title: His Highness the Amir met Berlin Mayor Kai Wegner during a visit to the German capital's City Hall, discussing bilateral cooperation, ways …
item.description:
His Highness the Amir met Berlin Mayor Kai Wegner during a visit to the German capital's City Hall, discussing bilateral cooperation, ways to strengthen it and matters of mutual interest, in the presence of the Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs and members of the official delegation. His Highness also visited the Central Memorial of the Victims of War in Berlin and viewed the commemorative sculpture it houses.

item.title: A Special Forces brigade of the Qatar Armed Forces received final accreditation under the requirements of NATO Evaluation Level 2 (NEL-2) a…
item.description:
A Special Forces brigade of the Qatar Armed Forces received final accreditation under the requirements of NATO Evaluation Level 2 (NEL-2) after completing the Operational Alignment Programme assessed by a NATO evaluation team, under the patronage of Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs Sheikh Saoud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani and with the attendance of Chief of Staff Lieutenant General (Pilot) Jassim bin Mohammed Al Mannai. The programme aims to raise readiness and interoperability in a multinational environment.

item.title: Al Shamal snatched a 1-1 draw against Al Ahli in the Qatar Stars League at Al Thumama Stadium after Erik Exposito put Al Ahli ahead with a …
item.description:
Al Shamal snatched a 1-1 draw against Al Ahli in the Qatar Stars League at Al Thumama Stadium after Erik Exposito put Al Ahli ahead with a 74th-minute penalty, and Riyad Mahrez equalised with a spot-kick in the 90+10th minute despite Nassim Ben Aissa's sending-off in the 90+1st minute; both penalties were awarded after VAR reviews. The draw took both teams to 13 points (Al Shamal fifth, Al Ahli sixth), while Al Rayyan and Al Duhail lead on 21 points each, followed by Al Sadd on 18 and Al Arabi on 14; Al Sadd face Lusail on Friday at Jassim Bin Hamad Stadium.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/al-shamal-snatch-stoppage-time-draw-against-al-ahli · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738618/sport/football/mahrez-rescues-shamal-with-stoppage-time-penalty-against-ahli · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265526/sports/injury-time-penalty-helps-al-shamal-hold-ahli-1-1

item.title: Qatar opened their FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 campaign with a 2-0 Group A win over Panama at Aspire Zone, both goals coming in stoppage…
item.description:
Qatar opened their FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 campaign with a 2-0 Group A win over Panama at Aspire Zone, both goals coming in stoppage time: a Taha Nassir penalty in the 91st minute and an Abdoulaye Ndiaye goal in the 95th. The tournament features 48 teams and 104 matches, with the final at Ahmad Bin Ali Stadium on 13 December. Other opening-day results included Australia 2-0 Argentina, Uruguay 3-2 Saudi Arabia and Greece 2-1 Egypt. For the second year, Aspire Zone is staging eight matches a day in the group stage, and Minister of Sports and Youth and LOC Chairman Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa bin Ahmed Al Thani said the world of football is uniting in Qatar once again.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265515/sports/qatar-strike-twice-in-stoppage-time-to-make-winning-start-at-fifa-u-17-world-cup-2026 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/qatar-snatch-dramatic-late-win-over-panama · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/world-of-football-unites-in-qatar-sheikh-hamad

item.title: The second Doha International Music and Marching Festival (Doha Tattoo) runs from 14 to 17 December at Katara Cultural Village under the pa…
item.description:

item.title: The Saudi-led coalition on Friday struck Hodeidah port after urging civilians and workers to evacuate it. Its spokesman, Maj Gen Turki Al M…
item.description:
The Saudi-led coalition on Friday struck Hodeidah port after urging civilians and workers to evacuate it. Its spokesman, Maj Gen Turki Al Malki, said the strikes targeted operational capabilities used to smuggle weapons and ballistic missiles and that the operation was continuing in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz, after seven military targets and six workshops for assembling missile launchers and drones were destroyed at dawn. The Houthis responded by threatening Jeddah and Saudi Red Sea ports, declared Saudi airspace "unsafe" except over Makkah and Madinah, and urged people to leave Riyadh's financial district. The coalition said it intercepted a ballistic missile and five drones launched towards Riyadh and the southern region.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/20/saudi-led-coalition-tells-civilians-to-leave-yemens-hodeidah-port-ahead-of-strikes/ · Edition.mv (AFP) https://edition.mv/world/55938 · Morung Express (Xinhua) https://www.morungexpress.com/yemens-houthis-issue-multiple-threats-targeting-saudi-facilities-airspace

item.title: New details of Thursday's attack on Riyadh show that the missile struck the Public Investment Fund tower, the tallest skyscraper in King Ab…
item.description:
New details of Thursday's attack on Riyadh show that the missile struck the Public Investment Fund tower, the tallest skyscraper in King Abdullah Financial District at 80 storeys, shattering windows across seven to eight floors and bending parts of the metal facade; entrances to the district were closed and staff evacuated. It was the second hit on the financial district in under two weeks, after an Aramco building was struck on 8 November. The coalition said it had "dealt with a missile threat", and Saudi civil defence confirmed there were no injuries.

item.title: Arab condemnations of the attack followed: Kuwait described it as ballistic, cruise-missile and drone attacks violating Saudi sovereignty a…
item.description:
Arab condemnations of the attack followed: Kuwait described it as ballistic, cruise-missile and drone attacks violating Saudi sovereignty and said the Kingdom's security is inseparable from that of Kuwait and the GCC states; Oman condemned the targeting of civilian and economic facilities and called for an end to escalation, diplomatic dialogue and addressing the root causes of tension; and Egypt said Saudi security is part of its own national security and demanded an immediate halt to the attacks.

item.title: Oman's government signed a concession agreement with Energy Development Oman and ExxonMobil to appraise and develop discovered gas resource…
item.description:
Oman's government signed a concession agreement with Energy Development Oman and ExxonMobil to appraise and develop discovered gas resources in the Greater Makarem area (Block 20), with initial investment of more than USD 400 million, paving the way for an integrated gas production and liquefaction project worth several billion dollars. Developing the block supports the proposed LNG plant in the Duqm special economic zone, which targets 6 to 9 million tonnes a year, with no timeframe given for the appraisal phase.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199961/business/energy/energy-oman-exxonmobil-to-develop-greater-makarem-gas-duqm-lng · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179365-agreement-signed-to-develop-gas-resources-in-greater-makarem-establish-lng-production-facilities-at-duqm · AGBI https://www.agbi.com/oil-and-gas/2026/11/oman-strikes-deal-to-explore-new-lng-resources/

item.title: Brent fell 1.34% to USD 90.75 a barrel at 1:16pm UAE time on Friday, and US crude fell 1.2% to USD 81.36, later trading at USD 81.89 at the…
item.description:
Brent fell 1.34% to USD 90.75 a barrel at 1:16pm UAE time on Friday, and US crude fell 1.2% to USD 81.36, later trading at USD 81.89 at the New York open, putting Brent on course for a third weekly loss of more than 3% and WTI for a loss of more than 6%. Investors are weighing regional tension, including an attack on an ADNOC Logistics and Services vessel in the Strait of Hormuz that injured 11 seafarers and left one missing, against the market's return to surplus for the first time since the start of the Iran war, according to the IEA. US President Donald Trump said he was "not rushing" any decision on Iran.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/20/oil-on-track-to-post-weekly-decline-despite-middle-east-tension/ · Yahoo Finance https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-november-19-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-anthropic-nvidia-volatility-092827348.html

item.title: The executive plans for the "Egypt Forum 2026" recommendations set specific targets to 2030: 200,000 jobs in outsourcing and telecoms by ty…
item.description:
The executive plans for the "Egypt Forum 2026" recommendations set specific targets to 2030: 200,000 jobs in outsourcing and telecoms by tying training to specific vacancies; expanding Egyptian-Japanese schools from 103 to 500 over three years (2027/2028 to 2029/2030) at a cost of about EGP 30.5 billion; developing culture palaces at a cost of EGP 2.365 billion plus USD 500,000 for an app; and a plan to revive theatre and cinema worth about EGP 3.219 billion, targeting 2,558 theatre productions. The forum's recommendations were announced on 24 October.

Egyptian football returns after the international break: Kahraba Ismailia face Ceramica Cleopatra at 5pm on Friday in the Egypt Cup round of 16, then the ninth round of the Premier League starts on Monday 23 November with two big fixtures: El Gouna against Zamalek at 5pm at Khaled Bichara Stadium, with Zamalek third on 19 points from 8 matches, followed by the Al Ahly–Pyramids summit at 8pm at Cairo International Stadium; the round runs until Wednesday 25 November.

item.title: Wall Street opened mixed on Friday: the Dow Jones rose 0.60% to 49,391.53, the S&P 500 fell 0.21% to 7,160.61 after six losing sessions, an…
item.description:
Wall Street opened mixed on Friday: the Dow Jones rose 0.60% to 49,391.53, the S&P 500 fell 0.21% to 7,160.61 after six losing sessions, and the Nasdaq dropped 1.00% to 23,640.99 at 9:48am New York time. Nvidia fell 3.84% to USD 140.37, extending its losses to six sessions, and Anthropic shares slipped on their second trading day after closing at USD 97 on Thursday, staying above the USD 83 IPO price, while the VIX volatility index rose to 29.34.

item.title: Gold futures fell 3.14% to USD 3,569.60 an ounce at the New York open, with spot prices trading near USD 3,525; analysts say a break below …
item.description:
Gold futures fell 3.14% to USD 3,569.60 an ounce at the New York open, with spot prices trading near USD 3,525; analysts say a break below USD 3,500 could open the way to USD 3,400, then USD 3,300, as gold is sold alongside equities to raise cash while the dollar attracts defensive demand. Bitcoin dropped 3.10% to USD 61,510.65, its lowest since July, and the US 10-year Treasury yield eased to 4.988%.

item.title: Kyiv authorities restricted traffic on two bridges in the capital on Friday, and Mayor Vitali Klitschko urged residents to avoid driving in…
item.description:
Kyiv authorities restricted traffic on two bridges in the capital on Friday, and Mayor Vitali Klitschko urged residents to avoid driving into the city and businesses to allow remote work, after overnight Russian strikes killed at least three people in Kyiv and two in Lviv, according to local officials. The Dutch and Austrian embassies and Ukraine's Foreign Ministry building were damaged on Thursday, and Russian President Vladimir Putin vowed a "much more painful" response to the strikes on the Crimean Bridge, while Moscow said it intercepted 310 Ukrainian drones over more than a dozen Russian regions and Crimea.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/europe/2026/11/20/russia-strikes-three-kyiv-bridges-after-putin-vows-revenge-for-crimea-attack/ · The Copenhagen Post https://cphpost.dk/2026-11-20/global/russian-strikes-on-kyiv-kill-one-and-damage-austrian-and-dutch-embassies/ · Africanews https://www.africanews.com/amp/2026/11/20/ukraine-russian-strikes-damage-austrian-and-dutch-embassies-in-kyiv/ · The Kyiv Independent https://kyivindependent.com/breaking-dutch-embassy-damaged-in-russian-drone-strike-on-kyiv/

item.title: The International Court of Justice in The Hague ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, in a historic judgment…
item.description:
The International Court of Justice in The Hague ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, in a historic judgment in the case brought by Gambia with 11 intervening states, ordering safe passage home for refugees and compensation, and estimating that around 10,000 people were killed in the so-called "clearance operations". Al-Azhar welcomed the ruling as an important step towards justice for the victims and a victory for human rights.

item.title: US President Donald Trump and Chinese and Russian Presidents Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin held an unprecedented three-way meeting in Shenz…
item.description:
US President Donald Trump and Chinese and Russian Presidents Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin held an unprecedented three-way meeting in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific summit, discussing the war in Ukraine and nuclear arms control; Trump said he and Xi agreed oil must flow through the Strait of Hormuz, and Xinhua quoted Xi as saying nuclear weapons should be comprehensively prohibited. Putin said he and Trump "devoted considerable attention" to Ukraine, while Trump, back in Washington, appeared to push a decision on renewed strikes against Iran into next year: "We'll see what happens after January 1."
Sources: Oman Observer (Reuters) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199934/world/americas/trump-xi-putin-begin-historic-meeting-with-ukraine-war-on-agenda · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/20/oil-on-track-to-post-weekly-decline-despite-middle-east-tension/ · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/europe/2026/11/20/russia-strikes-three-kyiv-bridges-after-putin-vows-revenge-for-crimea-attack/

item.description:
The sell-off deepened in Asia on Friday despite Anthropic's record IPO, which raised $81.3 billion: Japan's Nikkei fell about 4.5% and South Korea's KOSPI about 4.5% in morning trade after opening at 57,051 and 4,942 points, while the Hang Seng fell nearly 2%, Shanghai 1.7% and Australia's S&P/ASX 200 1.6%. Asian shares are heading for their worst week in months on worries about AI spending.

item.title: Hungary is set to lift its objection to opening the last two negotiating clusters in Ukraine's and Moldova's EU accession path (agriculture…
item.description:
Hungary is set to lift its objection to opening the last two negotiating clusters in Ukraine's and Moldova's EU accession path (agriculture and the green agenda) at today's meeting of EU ambassadors, after blocking them on 20 October and 10 November. Diplomats expect all six clusters to open in December 2026, while the Commission sends its Moldova report in the week starting 23 November.

item.description:
The US Federal Reserve remains the market driver: the dollar is near a 19-month high, the yen at 159.22 per dollar and the euro at $1.0970, while the 10-year Treasury yield eased to 5.04% from 5.07%. Markets price about a 90% chance of a 25-basis-point hike in December and 10% for 50 points.
